newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: SOCCER-CZECH REPUBLIC V YUGOSLAVIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CZECH REPUBLIC V YUGOSLAVIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's World Cup European group six qualifier between the Czech Republic and Yugoslavia:

Czech Republic - 1-Ludek Miklosko; 2-Radoslav Latal, 3-Tomas Repka, 4-Petr Nedved, 5-Miroslav Kadlec, 6-Michal Hornak, 7-Martin Cizek, 8-Karel Poborsky, 9-Pavel Kuka, 10-Vladimir Smicer, 11-Radek Bejbl.

Yugoslavia - 1-Ivica Kralj; 2-Zoran Mirkovic, 3-Dejan Govedarica, 4-Slavisa Jokanovic, 5-Miroslav Djukic, 6-Sinisa Mihajlovic, 7-Vladimir Jugovic, 8-Dejan Savicevic, 9-Predrag Mijatovic, 10-Dragan Stojkovic, 11-Albert Nadj.
